notes: Two routes («ح») with different teachers and different Zuhri-level names: each is its own group and the tail is null
«زاد حرملة في روايته قال ابن شهاب» is Harmala's added remark (Ibn Shihab's own words), not a route, so it is left out
Both routes carry the same saying (the clapping and glorifying in prayer); the Prophet is the end, Abu Hurayra the last link
«أنهما سمعا أبا هريرة» (rule 5, «سمع») makes Abu Hurayra the last link of the second route
